lines.quote: Gulf oil is still flowing despite a surge in attacks on ships
lines.note: THE HEADLINE: flow credited ('still'), attacks sized as a 'surge' — H6's Z-assertion in LI register
lines.zWhy: 'still flowing' asserts the open Strait before the count

lines.quote: operators are braving the Strait, but risks are high and transport costs have skyrocketed
lines.note: THE DEK: the price attached — Hochstein's $1.4M/day line (BP 10-15) as a dek; 'braving' and 'skyrocketed' the two vehicles
lines.zWhy: if passage costs this much, control is nominal — the LI concession

lines.quote: Iran is hitting a lot more tankers, but operators are still going through, transporting oil in significant volumes
lines.note: restates the headline with 'a lot more' and 'significant' — both unsized

lines.quote: 26 vessels struck so far this month — the most dangerous period of the war; on Wednesday a 730-foot container ship sank after a projectile hit it
lines.note: THE RECORD against the claim: the count of strikes and the sinking (BP's Singapore-flagged ship, 10-14), dated

lines.quote: under US military protection tankers had been returning in greater numbers; Middle East exports got close to prewar levels last month
lines.note: THE CONTROL LINE: protection → return → near-prewar exports — the institutional read of H6, dated to September
lines.zWhy: prewar levels under escort reads as control working, last month

lines.quote: Iran's escalated attacks appear aimed at reversing the surge, but tracker data suggest the recovery has held up
lines.note: the mechanism: attacks vs escort, with the trackers as the referee
lines.zWhy: 'held up' credits the escort over the attacks

lines.quote: TankerTrackers: over 12 million barrels of crude a day through the waterway on average this month, slightly above September — “Exports continue to strengthen”
lines.note: THE COUNT (one tracker): up month on month; → H6 record — under the 15M line, but crude only
lines.zWhy: up month on month reads as open

lines.quote: Kpler: nearly 10 million barrels of oil a day this month, down from around 11 million in September
lines.note: THE COUNT (the other tracker): down month on month — the lede's own split; → H6 record, also under 15M
lines.zWhy: down month on month reads as closing — the paywall falls here
